sources.entry: Jupyter Notebook Viewer - Notebook viewer for macOS.

summary.one_liner: A native macOS app for viewing Jupyter/IPython notebook files, with a Quick Look plugin for previewing them in Finder.
summary.what_it_does: The app is a stand-alone macOS viewer for Jupyter/IPython notebooks, built on nbviewer.js according to the README. It includes an integrated Quick Look generator so notebooks can be previewed from Finder. Installation is either by downloading nbviewer-app.zip from the Releases page and moving the .app into /Applications, or via Homebrew Cask with `brew install --cask jupyter-notebook-viewer`. The README says Quick Look should work out of the box and gives a `qlmanage -m plugins | grep ipynb` command to check whether the plugin is registered. The project is MIT licensed.
use_cases: view Jupyter notebooks on a Mac without running Jupyter
preview .ipynb files with Quick Look in Finder
install a notebook viewer via Homebrew
how_to_run: Download nbviewer-app.zip from the Releases page
Unzip and move Jupyter Notebook Viewer.app to /Applications
Or install via Homebrew: brew install --cask jupyter-notebook-viewer
Check Quick Look plugin: qlmanage -m plugins | grep ipynb
notable: Stand-alone viewer built on nbviewer.js, so no Jupyter installation is needed
Integrated Quick Look generator for .ipynb previews in Finder
caveats: Only for macOS, as a native app
README gives no details on notebook rendering limits or supported nbformat versions
